— https://nitter.net/mattdpearce/status/1878607938547585212#m

TAX ZUCKERBERG, FUND KICK-ASS LOCAL JOURNALISTS 

mattdpearce.substack.com/p/c…
another quiet night in gotham. they fixed the bank. theres no way its going to happen again

terrible. 20 years ago, the internet was full of hobbyist blogs and forums. over time, these have been replaced by paywalled substacks and private discord channels, each a walled garden. google's decision to prioritize AI just makes it less likely people will create free, public info

Somehow this plan didn’t work.

www.nytimes.com/2026/05/19/u...

Stories like this one going around today are why I'm skeptical of the trust-but-verify AI crowd. Totally predictable that people who are too confident in their own mastery of these things will slip into the lazy corner-cutting that they think they're too smart for! www.nytimes.com/2026/05/19/b...

He's right 

And it's gonna blow up in everyone's faces once it becomes clear that the automated AI plagiarism software is cannibalizing stuff that was already plagiarized and repeating lies and errors
We keep creating and recreating an internet that destroys all incentives for producing original information mattdpearce.substack.com/p/you-couldn...

“..luck is other people..” 

Swoon 🥰
Also I loved this Coetzee passage:

To the young people booing AI graduation speakers, I salute you.

mattdpearce.substack.com/p/to-the-you...

10/10, all priors confirmed: 

www.nytimes.com/2026/05/18/w...

Five people are dead including two gunmen who police said entered the Islamic Center of San Diego on Monday morning and opened fire.
latimes.com/california/l...

I wrote an essay for young graduates (the places you’ll go etc) but because it’s my newsletter I can also talk about whatever I want, such as this cool painting I found.

mattdpearce.substack.com/p/to-the-you...
man, though idiotic, and knowing not what he does, yet full of the sweet things of love and gratitude

Pierre Louis Alexandre (he may have swedified is surname to Alexandersson at the end of his life) is probably one of the most portrayed non-royals in Swedish 19th century portraiture which is really cool.
It’s from the National Gallery of Art’s description!
One of the histories available about Pierre Louis Alexandre: www.athenaartfoundation.org/pierre-louis...
it’s all about the denominator, judge
read this yesterday and was immediately struck by that painting, it is indeed very cool
